failuresAndRecovery.finding: Gallery objects contain numberLabel but no number field
failuresAndRecovery.resolution: Render ordinal from preserved array order; original labels and page meaning remain unchanged; both engines pass gallery and upgrade checks.

failuresAndRecovery.finding: Scene retry assertion assumed selection was cleared; matching helper clicked an existing pair twice and unintentionally removed it
failuresAndRecovery.resolution: Observe real widget contract, retain selected ship and relative geometry, explicitly withdraw a pair, fill missing pairs and correct only wrong pairs. No product or timeout relaxation.

failuresAndRecovery.finding: Older login suite retained 15-star assertion and queried both course and settlement cards
failuresAndRecovery.resolution: Use five-star expectation and the actual stage-certificate container. Preserve original frozen 15-star coverage independently.

failuresAndRecovery.finding: Fixed /lesson/ login test was accidentally batched with a root-mounted service
failuresAndRecovery.resolution: Keep failed report; rerun fixed entry tests under /lesson/ while their dedicated root server continues to verify root mounting. Do not restore retired production routes.

failuresAndRecovery.finding: Inherited writing-B page break wasted space
failuresAndRecovery.resolution: Remove section page break, retaining all 29 lines at 32px and complete A5/B12; two-page actual PDF visually reviewed.

reuse: Tests deduplicated by engine, actual intended mount, source file and title. Final 47 unanswered screenshots use final wording. Print pagination affects no task identity or grade. The changed account-name/old-name separation case is rerun in both engines and both mounts. Initial failures retained; no grading, timeout or assertion thresholds loosened.
pending: physical Android and iPhone WeChat saving
scopeBoundary: Scoped development checks. check:plan captured 5332 existing uncommitted paths; pre-task baseline limits this turn to 54 source/asset/doc/test paths plus evidence. No full repository commit check or production release claimed.
